# `aitbc ai jobs`

List AI jobs from the coordinator with optional status and limit filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ai jobs [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `10` | no | Limit results |
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ai jobs
```
